data-turbolinks="false"><div class="markdown-body safe-html-box__Uwc6Al"><ul dir="auto">
<li>Add support for <code class="notranslate">If-Unmodified-Since</code> to the <code class="notranslate">PUT</code> operation
<ul dir="auto">
<li>This creates an atomic operation that only stores the document if it hasn't been updated after the specified time</li>
<li>The atomicity is similar to that introduced by <code class="notranslate">Create-If: search-empty</code> for <span class="reference"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-issue-closed closed mr-1" title="Closed" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M11.28 6.78a.75.75 0 0 0-1.06-1.06L7.25 8.69 5.78 7.22a.75.75 0 0 0-1.06 1.06l2 2a.75.75 0 0 0 1.06 0l3.5-3.5Z"></path><path d="M16 8A8 8 0 1 1 0 8a8 8 0 0 1 16 0Zm-1.5 0a6.5 6.5 0 1 0-13 0 6.5 6.5 0 0 0 13 0Z"></path></svg><a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="2950562977" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/orbeon/orbeon-forms/issues/6902" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/orbeon/orbeon-forms/issues/6902/hovercard" href="https://github.com/orbeon/orbeon-forms/issues/6902">More robust Singleton form constraint checking<span class="issue-shorthand"> #6902</span></a></span></li>
<li>On failure, use <code class="notranslate">412 Precondition Failed</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>When re-encrypting, Orbeon Forms will:
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Read the data and note the <code class="notranslate">Last-Modified</code></li>
<li>When performing the <code class="notranslate">PUT</code>, provide that value as <code class="notranslate">If-Unmodified-Since</code></li>
<li>If the PUT fails, it means someone else saved the data after it was read, so start over from the first step</li>
</ol>
</li>
<li>Improvement: use ETags
<ul dir="auto">
<li>The GET returns a header <code class="notranslate">ETag: "686897696a7c876b7e"</code></li>
<li>The PUT adds a header <code class="notranslate">If-Match: "686897696a7c876b7e"</code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>All the above headers are part of HTTP/1.1</li>
</ul></div></div><div role="toolbar" aria-label="Reactions" class="d-flex gap-1 flex-wrap"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></li><li data-timeline-event-id="RTE_lADOAAPl9s4T5bXBzwAAAAQUoR34"
